prompt.zh-TW: 星河軟體的股價是 {{money:vars.sharePrice}}。今年本期淨利 {{money:vars.netIncome}}，股本 {{money:vars.shareCapital}}，每股面額 {{money:vars.parValue}}。請算出每股盈餘，取到小數點後兩位。注意：不是每一個數字都用得到。
prompt.en: Starriver Software trades at {{money:vars.sharePrice}} per share. This year its profit for the period is {{money:vars.netIncome}}, share capital is {{money:vars.shareCapital}} and par value is {{money:vars.parValue}} per share. Work out earnings per share to two decimal places. Note that not every figure is needed.

explanation.zh-TW: 每股盈餘只用損益表與資產負債表的數字：股數 ＝ 股本 ÷ 每股面額，每股盈餘 ＝ 本期淨利 ÷ 股數 ＝ {{number:expected.answer.value|digits=2}}。股價 {{money:vars.sharePrice}} 是市場的數字，要到下一步算本益比時才用得到。
explanation.en: Earnings per share uses only income statement and balance sheet figures: number of shares = share capital ÷ par value, and earnings per share = profit for the period ÷ number of shares = {{number:expected.answer.value|digits=2}}. The share price of {{money:vars.sharePrice}} is a market figure and is not needed until the next step, the P/E ratio.
